observed_behavior: The native Linux full suite reaches its final Delivery workspace subcommand and then reports 5 failures and 20 errors because ordinary artifact paths are classified as symlink or reparse redirects.
expected_behavior: Ordinary POSIX artifact paths pass stable no-follow validation, genuine symlinks remain fail closed, and all Delivery workspace transition oracles execute.
impact: The defect blocks the approved Linux full-suite and release gates while the same 17-command suite passes on Windows.

reproduction.symptom_oracle: The Linux full suite has exactly one failing subcommand before correction; ordinary directories classify false, genuine symlinks true, and Delivery workspace tests pass after the single-variable correction.
steps: Run the full project-knowledge suite in the native Linux validation copy.
Probe Delivery _is_reparse_path on an ordinary temporary directory.
Replace only missing POSIX st_file_attributes handling at runtime and rerun discoverable Delivery tests.
reproduction.sample: Full suite reproduced in one of one attempts; 100 discoverable Delivery tests passed in one of one controlled pre/post attempt.

root_cause.summary: The POSIX stat result lacks st_file_attributes. Delivery _is_reparse_path catches that AttributeError together with operating-system inspection errors and returns true, so normal paths fail before transition validation; treating only the absent Windows-specific member as zero restores the suite while retaining actual error and symlink rejection.

next_action: Implementation executor invalidates and re-executes WP-003, applies the single confirmed-cause Delivery POSIX classification fix, then resumes WP-004 Linux full verification and fresh review.
